inbound.step.endpoint.message: In Postal, open the mail server's Routing › HTTP Endpoints and add an endpoint with the URL {url}, the encoding Sent in the body as JSON and the format Delivered as the raw message.
inbound.step.endpoint.note: M58: a setup step of Receiving mail; Routing › HTTP Endpoints, Sent in the body as JSON and Delivered as the raw message are Postal's own words; url: ReputeCast's inbound address

inbound.step.route.message: Under Routing › Routes, add a route with the name * and the domain {domain}, with that HTTP endpoint as its endpoint. The domain must be one of the mail server's verified domains.
inbound.step.route.note: M58: a setup step; Routing › Routes is Postal's menu; * means every address of the domain; domain: reply.news.acme.io

inbound.step.mx.message: Point the MX record of {domain} at your Postal server, {host}, unless your Postal installation lists other MX hosts in its dns.mx_records setting.
inbound.step.mx.note: M58: a setup step; host: postal.acme.io; dns.mx_records is Postal's configuration key
